integrity: The infinite claim follows from the self-contained symbolic normal form and Fibonacci path count; the checker gives only finite corroboration. No independent audit or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-index two-representation statement is proved for nonadjacent indexed Lucas summands, not arbitrary Lucas recurrences. The unweighted collision set and unique canonical Lucas form are preexisting; the contribution is the finite-cutoff length-difference spectrum and limit. An implicit older weighted variant cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Exact excess-summand statistics for nonunique Lucas partitions
